source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Brakes, p.5-2

procedures.title: Brake system: general description
notes: Corvette parking brake routing: the cable goes forward from the lever to a pulley assembly on a frame crossmember, then rearward to an equalizer close to the rear frame crossmember. One single-piece rear cable runs through the equalizer and on to both rear brakes.
Figure 1 in the manual shows Delco Moraine and Bendix main cylinders in section; figure 2 shows the distribution and switch assembly on Chevrolet and Camaro.
